// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_boomerang/new-boomerang__000__35_23.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/boomerang/new-boomerang.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC shiny_boomerang-1-icon.png 35 23
// image: shiny_boomerang-1-icon.png
// tile: 35,23
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 488edb27bfe0

NPC shiny_boomerang-1-icon.png 35 23
// NPC made by Tricxta
//Credit goes to shiny for tile handling
if (playerenters){
  if (!isweapon)toweapons boomerang;
  this.boomtiles = {
    // STA,KE,TI,LES, ,REP,LAC,ETI,LES, ,STRENGTH(1 = default),LEAPS
    0x2  ,0x3  ,0x12 ,0x13 , ,0x2A5,0x2A6,0x2B5,0x2B6, ,1,0 , // BUSH
      0x200,0x201,0x210,0x211, ,0x70A,0x70B,0x71A,0x71B, ,1,3 , // SIGN
        0x2AC,0x2AD,0x2BC,0x2BD, ,0x6EA,0x6EB,0x6FA,0x6FB, ,2,2 , // VASE
          0x22 ,0x23 ,0x32 ,0x33 , ,0x72A,0x72B,0x73A,0x73B, ,2,2 , // LIGHT ROCK
            0x3DE,0x3DF,0x3EE,0x3EF, ,0x72A,0x72B,0x73A,0x73B, ,3,2 , // DARK ROCK
              };
}

if (weaponfired && this.boom.mode==0 && this.boom.dist<=3){
  setani shiny_boomerang-throw,shiny_boomerang-1.png;
  freezeplayer .35;
  this.boom.dx=0;
  this.boom.dy=0;
  this.boom.speed=1;
  setstring this.boom.extras,;
  this.originx=playerx+1.5;
  this.originy=playery+2;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
    if (keydown(this.i)){
      this.boom.dx+=vecx(this.i);
      this.boom.dy+=vecy(this.i);
    }
  }
  if (this.boom.dx==0 && this.boom.dy == 0){
    this.boom.dx+=vecx(playerdir);
    this.boom.dy+=vecy(playerdir);
  }
  this.boom.x=playerx+this.boom.dx;
  this.boom.y=playery+this.boom.dy;
  sleep .3;
  showani 1,this.boom.x,this.boom.y,0,shiny_boomerang,shiny_boomerang-1.png;
  this.boom.mode=1;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  this.boom.dist=(((this.boom.x-this.originx)^2)+((this.boom.y-this.originy)^2))^.5;
  if (onwall(this.boom.x+1.5,this.boom.y+2) && this.boom.mode==1){
    putleaps 4,this.boom.x+.5,this.boom.y+1;
    triggeraction this.boom.x+1.5,this.boom.y+2,Boomerang,;
  }
  if (!onwall(this.boom.x+1.5,this.boom.y+2) && this.boom.mode==1  && this.boom.dist<15){
    this.boom.x+=this.boom.dx*this.boom.speed;
    this.boom.y+=this.boom.dy*this.boom.speed;
    showani 1,this.boom.x,this.boom.y,0,shiny_boomerang,shiny_boomerang-1.png;
  }
  else {
    this.boom.dist=(((this.boom.x-playerx)^2)+((this.boom.y-playery)^2))^.5;
    this.boom.mode=0;
    if (this.boom.dist<=3){
      for (i=0;i<int(sarraylen(this.boom.extras)/3);i++) {
        if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 0) playerrupees += 1;
        else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 1) playerrupees += 5;
        else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 2) playerrupees += 30;
        else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 3) playerbombs += 5;
        else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 4) playerdarts += 5;
        else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 5) playerhearts += 1;
        else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 19) playerrupees += 100;
        play extra.wav;
      }
      hideimg 1;
      break;
    }
    else {
      this.boom.x+=((this.boom.x-playerx)/abs(this.boom.x-playerx))*(this.boom.speed*-1);
      this.boom.y+=((this.boom.y-playery)/abs(this.boom.y-playery))*(this.boom.speed*-1);
      showani 1,this.boom.x,this.boom.y,0,shiny_boomerang,shiny_boomerang-1.png;
    }
  }
  CheckDrops();
  CheckTiles();
  timeout=0.05;
}

function CheckDrops() {
  this.checkitem = testitem(this.boom.x+1.5,this.boom.y+2);
  if (this.checkitem >= 0) {
    insertstring this.boom.extras,0,#v(random(-1,1));
    insertstring this.boom.extras,0,#v(random(-1,1));
    insertstring this.boom.extras,0,#v(items[this.checkitem].type);
    take2 this.checkitem;
    play extra.wav;
  }
  for (i=0;i<int(sarraylen(this.boom.extras)/3);i++) {
    showimg 10+i,shiny_drops-1.png,this.boom.x+strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3+1))+.5,this.boom.y+strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3+2))+.5;
    changeimgpart 10+i,0,0,32,32;
    changeimgvis 10+i,0;
    if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 0) changeimgpart 10+i,0*32,0,32,32;
    else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 1) changeimgpart 10+i,1*32,0,32,32;
    else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 2) changeimgpart 10+i,2*32,0,32,32;
    else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 3) changeimgpart 10+i,3*32,0,32,32;
    else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 4) changeimgpart 10+i,4*32,0,32,32;
    else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 5) changeimgpart 10+i,5*32,0,32,32;
    else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 19) changeimgpart 10+i,6*32,0,32,32;
  }
}

function CheckTiles() {
  for (i=0;i<9;i++) {
    this.objtile = -1;
    for (j=0;j<int(arraylen(this.boomtiles)/12);j++) {
      if (tiles[this.boom.x+(i%3),this.boom.y+int(i/3)] == this.boomtiles[j*12]) {
        this.checkx = int(this.boom.x+(i%3));
        this.checky = int(this.boom.y+int(i/3));
        this.objtile = j;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (this.objtile >= 0) {
      putleaps this.boomtiles[11+this.objtile*12],this.checkx,this.checky;
      for (j=0;j<4;j++) {
        tiles[this.checkx+(j%2),this.checky+int(j/2)] = this.boomtiles[this.objtile*12+5+j];
      }
      updateboard this.checkx,this.checky,2,2;
    }
  }
}

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_boomerang_quest/baddywallbeast__000__0_0.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/boomerang quest/baddywallbeast.txt
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 0 0
// image: -
// tile: 0,0
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 87784b2f2235

NPC - 0 0
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){

  if (save[0] == 0){
    save[0] = x;
	save[1] = y;
  }
  dontblock;
  setcharani ph_wall-beast,shrimp_dragfire.gif;
  if (this.gotRoute == 0){
    this.gotRoute = 1;
    getRoute();
  }
  
  if (sarraylen(this.route) == 0){//covers a bug for use in multiplayer levels
    x = save[0];
	y = save[1];
	
	getRoute();
  }

  x = strtofloat(#I(this.route,this.pos*2));
  y = strtofloat(#I(this.route,this.pos*2+1));

  if (this.speed == 0)this.speed = 0.2;
  this.speed = min(1,this.speed);
  
  timereverywhere;

  timeout = 0.05;
}

if (Boomerang){
  this.stunTimer = 5;
}

  getRoute();
}

if (timeout){
  if (isleader && this.stunTimer <= 0){
    this.pointTo = {strtofloat(#I(this.route,this.pos*2)),strtofloat(#I(this.route,this.pos*2+1))};
    this.distTo = ((x+1-this.pointTo[0])^2+(y+1.5-this.pointTo[1])^2)^0.5;

    if (this.distTo < this.speed){
      x = strtofloat(#I(this.route,this.pos*2))-1;
      y = strtofloat(#I(this.route,this.pos*2+1))-1.5;
      this.pos = (this.pos+1)%(sarraylen(this.route)/2);
    }

    this.dx = strtofloat(#I(this.route,this.pos*2))-1-x;          this.dx = abs(this.dx)/this.dx;
    this.dy = strtofloat(#I(this.route,this.pos*2+1))-1.5-y;      this.dy = abs(this.dy)/this.dy;

    x += this.dx * this.speed;
    y += this.dy * this.speed;
  }
  else {
    this.stunTimer -= 0.05;
  }

  if (playerx+1.5 in |x+0.5,x+2.5| && playery+2 in |y+1,y+3|){
    hurt 1;
  }

  timeout = 0.05;
}


function getRoute(){
  this.testDir = 2;
  this.testC = {x,y};
  this.pointFrom = this.testC;
  this.testInd = y*64+x;
  this.found = 1;
  setstring this.route,;
  setstring this.recorded,;

  while (this.found == 1){
    this.found = 0;
    addstring this.route,#v(this.testC[0]);
    addstring this.route,#v(this.testC[1]);

    addstring this.recorded,#v(this.testInd);

    this.wallSave = this.pointFrom;

    this.distRec = 64;//make a distance that can be easily beaten
    for (this.d = 0; this.d < 4; this.d++){
      this.newDir = (this.testDir+this.d)%4;
      this.newTestC = {this.testC[0]+vecx(this.newDir),this.testC[1]+vecy(this.newDir)};
      this.testInd = this.newTestC[1]*64+this.newTestC[0];

      isBorder();
      this.distTo = (abs(this.newTestC[0]-this.wallSave[0])^2+abs(this.newTestC[1]-this.wallSave[1])^2)^0.5;

      if (!onwall(this.newTestC[0],this.newTestC[1]) && lindexof(#v(this.testInd),this.recorded) < 0 && this.distTo < this.distRec){
        if (this.border == 1){
          this.found = 1;
          this.tempDat = {this.newDir,this.newTestC[0],this.newTestC[1],this.testC[1]*64+this.testC[0],this.pointFrom[0],this.pointFrom[1]};
          this.distRec = this.distTo;
        }
      }
    }

    this.testC = {this.tempDat[1],this.tempDat[2]};
    this.testDir = this.tempDat[0];
    this.testInd = this.tempDat[3];
    this.pointFrom = {this.tempDat[4],this.tempDat[5]};

    //message #s(this.recorded);
    //showimg 300,plant.png,this.testC[0],this.testC[1];
    //changeimgpart 300,0,0,16,16;
    //showimg 301,plant.png,this.wallSave[0],this.wallSave[1];
    //changeimgpart 301,0,16,16,16;
    //sleep 0.1;
  }
}

function isBorder(){
  this.wallDist = 64;
  if (onwall(this.newTestC[0],this.newTestC[1]))return;

  this.border = 0;
  for (this.b = 0; this.b < 9; this.b++){
    this.pointCheck = {this.newTestC[0]-1+(this.b%3),this.newTestC[1]-1+int(this.b/3)};
    this.newWallDist = ((this.pointCheck[0]-this.wallSave[0])^2+(this.pointCheck[1]-this.wallSave[1])^2)^0.5;
    if (onwall(this.pointCheck[0],this.pointCheck[1]) && this.newWallDist < this.wallDist){
      this.wallDist = this.newWallDist;
      this.pointFrom = this.pointCheck;
      this.border = 1;
    }
  }
}

  else {//GUARD LOGIC
    this.distFromPost = ((x+1.5-this.guardPoint[0])^2+(y+2-this.guardPoint[1])^2)^0.5;
    this.distFromPostToPlayer = ((playerx+1.5-this.guardPoint[0])^2+(playery+2-this.guardPoint[1])^2)^0.5;
    this.distToPlayer = ((playerx-x)^2+(playery-y)^2)^0.5;

    if (this.distFromPostToPlayer <= this.guardRadius){
      if (this.distToPlayer <= this.attackRadius){//attack
        setcharani sword,;
        this.mode = this.mode_Attack;

        this.idleTimer = 0.3;
      }
      else {
        this.pointTo = {playerx+1.5,playery+2};//move to player
        if (random(0,100) < 10 && this.chatTimer <= 0){
          this.chatTimer = 2;
          message stay away from my pretty!;
        }

        this.mode = this.mode_MoveTo;
      }
    }
    else if (this.distFromPostToPlayer > this.guardRadius){
      this.pointTo = this.guardPoint;//move to guard point
      this.mode = this.mode_MoveTo;
    }
    else this.mode = this.mode_Idle;


    if (this.mode == this.mode_MoveTo){
      moveTo();
    }

    if (this.mode == this.mode_Idle){
      dir = getdir(playerx-x,playery-y);

      if (this.chatTimer <= 0 && random(0,100) < 3){//taunt
        message #R(#s(this.Taunts));
        this.chatTimer = 4;
      }
    }
  }

  timeout = 0.05;
}

function moveTo(){
  this.tempDist = {this.pointTo[0]-(x+1.5),this.pointTo[1]-(y+2)};
  this.angleTo = getangle(this.tempDist[0],-this.tempDist[1]);
  this.distToPoint = (this.tempDist[0]^2+this.tempDist[1]^2)^0.5;

  if (this.distToPoint <= this.speed || (this.tempDist == this.oldDist)){
    setcharani idle,;
    this.mode = this.mode_Idle;
    return;
  }

  this.oldDist = this.tempDist;

  setcharani walk,;
  dir = getdir(this.tempDist[0],this.tempDist[1]);

  //move x
  this.wallCheck = {int(x+0.5+cos(this.angleTo)*this.speed + 0.5),int(y + 1 + 0.5)};
  checkWall();
  if (this.onwallCheck == 0)x += cos(this.angleTo)*this.speed;

  //move y
  this.wallCheck = {int(x+0.5+0.5),int(y+1+sin(this.angleTo)*this.speed + 0.5)};
  checkWall();
  if (this.onwallCheck == 0)y += sin(this.angleTo)*this.speed;

}

function checkWall(){
  this.onwallCheck = 0;
  for (this.w = 0; this.w < 4; this.w++)
    this.onwallCheck += (onwall(this.wallCheck[0]+(this.w%2),this.wallCheck[1]+int(this.w/2)));
}

if (tauntPlayer){
  this.chatTimer = 3;
  this.idleTimer = 2;
  message #R(#s(this.rockTaunts));
}

if (squished){
  this.dead = 1;
  message Haha, you'll never defeat me!;
  setcharani idle,;
  dir = 2;

  this.lights = lighteffectsenabled;
  for (this.f = 0; this.f <= 30; this.f += 0.5){
    showimg 300,ph_boulder-fall.png,x-0.5,y-0.5;
    changeimgpart 300,(1-this.lights)*64+64,0,64,64;
    if (this.lights == 1){
      changeimgmode 300,1;
      changeimgcolors 300,1,1,1,min(0.9,this.f/10);
      changeimgvis 300,0;
    }
    if (this.f > 10){
      message ...;
      showimg 301,ph_boulder-fall.png,x-0.5,y-0.5-(30-this.f);
      changeimgpart 301,0,0,64,64;
      changeimgvis 301,1;
    }

    sleep 0.05;
  }
  hideimg 300;
  message ;
  sleep 1;
  message ughh..;
  sleep 2;
  message ;
}

  this.red = 0;
  this.timerAl = 3;
  this.timer = 0;
  timeout = 0.05;
  y=30.5;

  if (this.timer > 0){
    this.timer -= 0.05;
    if (this.red < 1)
      this.red+=0.05;
  }
  else if (this.red > 0 && this.timer <= 0){
    this.red -= 0.05;
  }

  this.track = (this.track+0.1)%(pi*2);
  this.fade = sin(this.track)*0.2;
  showimg 300,light4.png,x-3,y-3;

}

  for (this.n = 0; this.n < npcscount; this.n++){
    callnpc this.n,wasCommanded,;
  }
}

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_boomerang_quest/quest_boom15__001__6_28.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/boomerang quest/quest_boom15.nw
// npc-index: 1
// header: NPC - 6 28
// image: -
// tile: 6,28
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 5d04c20d7619

NPC - 6 28
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  if (strtofloat(#I(client.questBoomerang,0)) >= 3){
    return;
  }

  this.bounds = {25,25,16,14};//x,y,w,h
  this.maxHealth = 5;
  this.health = this.maxHealth;
  this.active = 0;
  this.switches = 4;

  timeout = 0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  level.activeSwitch = int(random(0,this.switches));
  this.tick ++;

  play put.wav;//change this?
  timeout = (this.tick%5 == 0)?4:random(1,3);
}

if (switchTriggered){
  if (this.health <= 0 || this.active == 1 || strtofloat(#p(0)) <> level.activeSwitch)return;
  play extra.wav;

  this.active = 1;

  for (this.n = 0; this.n < npcscount; this.n++){
    callnpc this.n,tauntPlayer,;
  }

  this.health --;
  this.magnitude = this.maxHealth-this.health;
  if (this.health >= 0){
    for (this.i = 0; this.i < this.magnitude*2; this.i+=0.05){
      this.dropC = {this.bounds[0]+random(0,this.bounds[2]),this.bounds[1]+random(0,this.bounds[3])};
      putleaps 3,this.dropC[0],this.dropC[1];
      setfocus playerx+1.5,playery+2+sin((this.i^2)*(pi*2))*this.i;
      if (this.dropC[0] in |playerx+0.5,playerx+2.5| && this.dropC[1] in |playery+1,playery+3|){
        hurt 1;
      }
      sleep 0.05;
    }
    resetfocus;
  }
  if (this.health == 0){//cutscene!
    for (this.n = 0; this.n < npcscount; this.n++)callnpc this.n,squished,;
  }
  this.active = 0;

  timeout = 0.05;
}

if (bossDead){
  replacestring client.questBoomerang,0,3;
  break;
}

NPCEND

// npc-index: 2
// header: NPC - 30 29
// image: -
// tile: 30,29
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 76daf983bc76

NPC - 30 29
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  if (strtofloat(#I(client.questBoomerang,0)) >= 3){
    hide;
    break;
  }

  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #3,head428.png;
  setcharprop #8,body4.png;
  setcharprop #C0,lightblue;
  setcharprop #C1,lightgray;
  setcharprop #C2,lightgray;
  setcharprop #C3,lightblue;
  setcharprop #C4,lightblue;
  setcharprop #2,no-shield.png;

  dontblock;
  this.guardRadius = 11.9;
  this.attackRadius = 3;
  this.guardPoint = {32,32};

  setarray this.oldDist,2;

  this.speed = 0.35;
  swordpower = 2;

  this.idleTimer = 0;
  this.chatTimer = 0;

  this.mode_Idle = 0;
  this.mode_Attack = 1;
  this.mode_MoveTo = 2;

  this.mode = 0;

  setstring this.Taunts,
    "I'ma lock you up! Come here!",
    "You dink you can beat me, heh!",
    "Puny human, I squish you like fly";

  setstring this.rockTaunts,
    "little pebbles do not hurt me!",
    "pebble!? hahh, it take somethin bigger den dat to hurt me!";

  setstring this.retreatTaunts,
    "Human scared, he run away!",
    "haha human cowered, come back n fight!";

  this.dead = 0;

  timeout = 0.05;
}

if (Boomerang){
  this.idleTimer = 4;
  setcharani ph_stunned-emote,;
  this.chatTimer = 2;
  message gr...;
  timeout = 0.05;
}

if (wasHit){
  this.chatTimer = 2;
  message haha, you puny sword no hurt me!;
}

if (timeout && this.dead == 0){
  if (this.chatTimer > 0)this.chatTimer -= 0.05;
  else message ;

  if (this.idleTimer > 0)this.idleTimer -= 0.05;
  else {//GUARD LOGIC
    this.distFromPost = ((x+1.5-this.guardPoint[0])^2+(y+2-this.guardPoint[1])^2)^0.5;
    this.distFromPostToPlayer = ((playerx+1.5-this.guardPoint[0])^2+(playery+2-this.guardPoint[1])^2)^0.5;
    this.distToPlayer = ((playerx-x)^2+(playery-y)^2)^0.5;

    if (this.distFromPostToPlayer <= this.guardRadius){
      if (this.distToPlayer <= this.attackRadius){//attack
        setcharani sword,;
        this.mode = this.mode_Attack;

        this.idleTimer = 0.3;
      }
      else {
        this.pointTo = {playerx+1.5,playery+2};//move to player
        if (random(0,100) < 10 && this.chatTimer <= 0){
          this.chatTimer = 2;
          message stay away from my pretty!;
        }

        this.mode = this.mode_MoveTo;
      }
    }
    else if (this.distFromPostToPlayer > this.guardRadius){//retreat to guard position
      if (this.chatTimer <= 0 && random(0,100) < 5){
        message #R(#s(this.retreatTaunts));
        this.chatTimer = 3;
      }
      //create point closest to player & post
      this.angleToPlayer = getangle(playerx-x,y-playery);
      this.newGuardPoint = {
        this.guardPoint[0]+cos(this.angleToPlayer)*(this.guardRadius/4),
        this.guardPoint[1]+sin(this.angleToPlayer)*(this.guardRadius/4)
      };
      //----

      this.pointTo = this.newGuardPoint;//move to guard point
      this.mode = this.mode_MoveTo;
    }
    else this.mode = this.mode_Idle;


    if (this.mode == this.mode_MoveTo){
      moveTo();
    }

    if (this.mode == this.mode_Idle){
      dir = getdir(playerx-x,playery-y);

      if (this.chatTimer <= 0 && random(0,100) < 1){//taunt
        message #R(#s(this.Taunts));
        this.chatTimer = 4;
      }
    }
  }

  timeout = 0.05;
}

function moveTo(){
  this.tempDist = {this.pointTo[0]-(x+1.5),this.pointTo[1]-(y+2)};
  this.angleTo = getangle(this.tempDist[0],-this.tempDist[1]);
  this.distToPoint = (this.tempDist[0]^2+this.tempDist[1]^2)^0.5;

  if (this.distToPoint <= this.speed || (this.tempDist == this.oldDist)){
    setcharani idle,;
    this.mode = this.mode_Idle;
    return;
  }

  this.oldDist = this.tempDist;

  setcharani walk,;
  dir = getdir(this.tempDist[0],this.tempDist[1]);

  //move x
  this.wallCheck = {int(x+0.5+cos(this.angleTo)*this.speed + 0.5),int(y + 1 + 0.5)};
  checkWall();
  if (this.onwallCheck == 0)x += cos(this.angleTo)*this.speed;

  //move y
  this.wallCheck = {int(x+0.5+0.5),int(y+1+sin(this.angleTo)*this.speed + 0.5)};
  checkWall();
  if (this.onwallCheck == 0)y += sin(this.angleTo)*this.speed;

}

function checkWall(){
  this.onwallCheck = 0;
  for (this.w = 0; this.w < 4; this.w++)
    this.onwallCheck += (onwall(this.wallCheck[0]+(this.w%2),this.wallCheck[1]+int(this.w/2)));
}

if (tauntPlayer){
  this.chatTimer = 5;
  this.idleTimer = 5;
  sleep 2;
  message #R(#s(this.rockTaunts));

  timeout = 0.05;
}

if (squished){
  this.dead = 1;
  message Haha, you'll never defeat me!;
  setcharani idle,;
  dir = 2;

  this.lights = lighteffectsenabled;
  for (this.f = 0; this.f <= 30; this.f += 0.5){
    showimg 300,ph_boulder-fall.png,x-0.5,y-0.5;
    changeimgpart 300,(1-this.lights)*64+64,0,64,64;
    if (this.lights == 1){
      changeimgmode 300,1;
      changeimgcolors 300,1,1,1,min(0.9,this.f/10);
      changeimgvis 300,0;
    }
    if (this.f > 10){
      message ...;
      showimg 301,ph_boulder-fall.png,x-0.5,y-0.5-(30-this.f);
      changeimgpart 301,0,0,64,64;
      changeimgvis 301,1;
    }

    sleep 0.05;
  }
  hideimg 300;
  message ;
  sleep 1;
  message ughh..;
  sleep 2;
  message ;
  for (this.n = 0; this.n < npcscount; this.n++){
    callnpc this.n,bossDead,;
  }
}

    if (strequals(#s(this.cmd),talk))
      message #I(this.scene,this.s*3+2);

    else if (strequals(#s(this.cmd),dir))
      dir = strtofloat(#I(this.scene,this.s*3+2));

    else if (strequals(#s(this.cmd),move)){
      setcharani walk,;
      for (this.d = 0; this.d < strtofloat(#I(this.scene,this.s*3+2)); this.d+=this.speed){
        x += vecx(dir)*this.speed;  y += vecy(dir)*this.speed;
        setfocus x,y;
        sleep 0.05;
      }
      setcharani idle,;
    }

    else if (strequals(#s(this.cmd),wait)){resetfocus;while(level.freed == 0)sleep 0.05;}

    else if (strequals(#s(this.cmd),giveKey)){
      setcharani grab,;
      for (this.n = 0; this.n < npcscount; this.n++)callnpc this.n,placeKey,#v(x+0.5+vecx(dir)*2),#v(y+1+vecy(dir)*2);

      sleep 0.5;
    }

    sleep strtofloat(#I(this.scene,this.s*3+1));
  }
  resetfocus;
  hide;
}

// image: ph_key1.png

NPC ph_key1.png 55 29
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  setshape 1,32,32;
  hide;

  this.distToSee = 15;
}

if (getInfo){
  setstring client.description,A key which is rumoured to unlock a dungeon.;
}

if (placeKey){
  x = strtofloat(#p(0));
  y = strtofloat(#p(1));
  show;
}

if (playertouchsme){
  hide;
  toweapons Mysterious-Key;
  replacestring client.questBoomerang,0,4;
  show();
  for (this.w = 0; this.w < weaponscount; this.w++){
    if (strequals(#w(this.w),-System/notify))
      callweapon this.w,notify,"You received a mysterious key!";
  }
}

if (weaponfired){
  show();
  for (this.npcIndex = 0; this.npcIndex < npcscount;this.npcIndex++){
    this.npcDist = ((playerx+1.5-npcs[this.npcIndex].x+npcs[this.npcIndex].width/2)^2 + (playery+2-npcs[this.npcIndex].y+npcs[this.npcsIndex].height/2)^2)^0.5;
    if (this.npcDist < this.distToSee)
      callnpc this.npcIndex,playerShowKey;
    else
      callnpc this.npcIndex,cantSeeItem;
  }
}

function show(){
  freezeplayer 2;
  setani ph_item-receieve,ph_key1.png;
}

    replacestring client.questBoomerang,1,#v(strtofloat(#I(client.questBoomerang,1))-1);

      changeimgmode 300,1;
      changeimgcolors 300,1,1,1,1-(this.i/3);
      sleep .05;
    }
    hideimg 300;
  }
}

function alertChange(){
  for (this.n = 0; this.n < npcscount; this.n++){//alert wallbeasts that path has changed
    callnpc this.n,updateRoute,;
  }
}

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_boomerang_quest/quest_boom8__019__9_8.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/boomerang quest/quest_boom8.nw
// npc-index: 19
// header: NPC shiny_boomerang-1-icon.png 9 8
// image: shiny_boomerang-1-icon.png
// tile: 9,8
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 3f7663deea2d

NPC shiny_boomerang-1-icon.png 9 8
//Made by Tricxta
//Credit to shiny for base functionality
if (playerenters){
  hide;
  if (!isweapon)return;

  if (strequals(#s(client.boomDat),))
    setstring client.boomDat,1,0,0,0,0;//level,extra data...
  this.boom.level = strtofloat(#I(client.boomDat,0));
  setimg shiny_boomerang-#v(this.boom.level)-icon.png;

  this.boomtiles = {
    // STA,KE,TI,LES, ,REP,LAC,ETI,LES, ,STRENGTH(1 = default),LEAPS
    0x2  ,0x3  ,0x12 ,0x13 , ,0x2A5,0x2A6,0x2B5,0x2B6, ,1,0 , // BUSH
    0x200,0x201,0x210,0x211, ,0x70A,0x70B,0x71A,0x71B, ,1,3 , // SIGN
    0x2AC,0x2AD,0x2BC,0x2BD, ,0x6EA,0x6EB,0x6FA,0x6FB, ,2,2 , // VASE
    0x22 ,0x23 ,0x32 ,0x33 , ,0x72A,0x72B,0x73A,0x73B, ,2,2 , // LIGHT ROCK
    0x3DE,0x3DF,0x3EE,0x3EF, ,0x72A,0x72B,0x73A,0x73B, ,3,2 , // DARK ROCK
  };

  this.passOverTiles = {
    0x278,0x11,0x60,0x20,0x21,0x70,0x9B8,0x9B9,
    0x11E,0x11F,0x807,0x808,0x829,0x82A,0x3CC,
    0x10E,0x10F,0xEC9,0xE3C,0xE3C
  };
  this.maxDistance = 15;
  this.curMapC = {onmapx(#L),onmapy(#L)};
  if (isonmap && this.oldMapC[0] >= 0 && this.oldMapC[1] >= 0){//move the boomerang to counter for the level change on maps
    this.change = {this.curMapC[0]-this.oldMapC[0],this.curMapC[1]-this.oldMapC[1]};
    this.boom.x -= this.change[0]*64;
    this.boom.y -= this.change[1]*64;
  }
  else {//discard the boomerang
    if (!isonmap){
      this.curMapC[0] = -1;
      this.curMapC[1] = -1;
    }
    this.boom.dist = 0;
    this.boom.mode = 0;
    this.boom.x = playerx;
    this.boom.y = playery;
    hideimg 1;
  }
  this.oldMapC = {this.curMapC[0],this.curMapC[1]};
}

if (getInfo){
  setstring client.description,Used to strike objects at a distance. While equipped use the arrow keys to choose the direction and press D to throw the boomerang. This boomerang can be thrown in vertical, horizontal and diagonally. Has the ability to strike certain switches, hurt baddies and stun players.;
}

if (addBoomerang){
  if (!isweapon){
    toweapons boomerang;
    for (this.w = 0; this.w < weaponscount; this.w++){
      if (strequals(#w(this.w),-System/notify))callweapon this.w,notify,You've received the boomerang!;
    }
  }
}

if (weaponfired && this.boom.mode==0 && this.boom.dist<=3){
  this.boom.level = strtofloat(#I(client.boomDat,0));
  setstring this.triggerNC,;
  setani shiny_boomerang-throw,shiny_boomerang-#v(this.boom.level).png;
  freezeplayer .35;
  this.boom.dx=0;
  this.boom.dy=0;
  this.boom.speed=1;
  setstring this.boom.extras,;
  this.originx=playerx+1.5;
  this.originy=playery+2;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
    if (keydown(this.i)){
      this.boom.dx+=vecx(this.i);
      this.boom.dy+=vecy(this.i);
    }
  }
  if (this.boom.dx==0 && this.boom.dy == 0){
    this.boom.dx+=vecx(playerdir);
    this.boom.dy+=vecy(playerdir);
  }
  this.boom.x=playerx+this.boom.dx;
  this.boom.y=playery+this.boom.dy;
  sleep .3;
  showani 1,this.boom.x,this.boom.y,0,shiny_boomerang,shiny_boomerang-#v(this.boom.level).png;
  this.boom.mode=1;
  timeout=0.05;
}
if (timeout){
  this.boom.dist=(((this.boom.x-this.originx)^2)+((this.boom.y-this.originy)^2))^.5;
  CheckDrops();
  CheckTiles();
  CheckNpcs();
  CheckBaddies();
  this.onwallCheck = ((onwall(this.boom.x+1.5,this.boom.y+2) && !(tiles[this.boom.x+1.5,this.boom.y+2] in this.passOverTiles)) || this.tBaddy >= 0);
  if (this.onwallCheck == 1 && this.boom.mode==1){
    putleaps 4,this.boom.x+.5,this.boom.y+1;
  }
  if (this.onwallCheck == 0 && this.boom.mode==1  && this.boom.dist < this.maxDistance){
    this.boom.x+=this.boom.dx*this.boom.speed;
    this.boom.y+=this.boom.dy*this.boom.speed;
    showani 1,this.boom.x,this.boom.y,0,shiny_boomerang,shiny_boomerang-#v(this.boom.level).png;
  }
  else {
    this.boom.dist=(((this.boom.x-playerx)^2)+((this.boom.y-playery)^2))^.5;
    this.boom.mode=0;
    if (this.boom.dist<=3){
      for (i=0;i<int(sarraylen(this.boom.extras)/3);i++) {
        if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 0) playerrupees += 1;
        else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 1) playerrupees += 5;
        else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 2) playerrupees += 30;
        else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 3) playerbombs += 5;
        else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 4) playerdarts += 5;
        else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 5) playerhearts += 1;
        else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 19) playerrupees += 100;
        play extra.wav;
      }
      hideimg 1;
      break;
    }
    else {
      this.returnAngle = getangle(this.boom.x-playerx,playery-this.boom.y);
      this.boom.x += cos(this.returnAngle)*(this.boom.speed*-1);
      this.boom.y += sin(this.returnAngle)*(this.boom.speed*-1);
      showani 1,this.boom.x,this.boom.y,0,shiny_boomerang,shiny_boomerang-1.png;
    }
  }
  timeout=0.05;
}
function CheckDrops() {
  this.checkitem = testitem(this.boom.x+1.5,this.boom.y+2);
  if (this.checkitem >= 0) {
    insertstring this.boom.extras,0,#v(random(-1,1));
    insertstring this.boom.extras,0,#v(random(-1,1));
    insertstring this.boom.extras,0,#v(items[this.checkitem].type);
    take2 this.checkitem;
    play extra.wav;
  }
  for (i=0;i<int(sarraylen(this.boom.extras)/3);i++) {
    showimg 10+i,shiny_drops-1.png,this.boom.x+strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3+1))+.5,this.boom.y+strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3+2))+.5;
    changeimgpart 10+i,0,0,32,32;
    changeimgvis 10+i,0;
    if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 0) changeimgpart 10+i,0*32,0,32,32;
    else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 1) changeimgpart 10+i,1*32,0,32,32;
    else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 2) changeimgpart 10+i,2*32,0,32,32;
    else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 3) changeimgpart 10+i,3*32,0,32,32;
    else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 4) changeimgpart 10+i,4*32,0,32,32;
    else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 5) changeimgpart 10+i,5*32,0,32,32;
    else if (strtofloat(#I(this.boom.extras,i*3)) == 19) changeimgpart 10+i,6*32,0,32,32;
  }
}
function CheckTiles() {
  for (i=0;i<9;i++) {
    this.objtile = -1;
    for (j=0;j<int(arraylen(this.boomtiles)/12);j++) {
      if (tiles[this.boom.x+(i%3),this.boom.y+int(i/3)] == this.boomtiles[j*12]) {
        this.checkx = int(this.boom.x+(i%3));
        this.checky = int(this.boom.y+int(i/3));
        this.objtile = j;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (this.objtile >= 0 && this.boom.level >= this.boomtiles[10+this.objtile*12]){
      putleaps this.boomtiles[11+this.objtile*12],this.checkx,this.checky;
      for (j=0;j<4;j++) {
        tiles[this.checkx+(j%2),this.checky+int(j/2)] = this.boomtiles[this.objtile*12+5+j];
      }
      updateboard this.checkx,this.checky,2,2;
    }
  }
}
function CheckNpcs(){
  this.tNpc = testnpc(this.boom.x+1.5,this.boom.y+2);
  if (this.tNpc >= 0 && lindexof(#v(this.tNpc),this.triggerNC) < 0){
    addstring this.triggerNC,#v(this.tNpc);
    callnpc this.tNpc,Boomerang,#v(this.boom.x+1.5),#v(this.boom.y+2);
  }
}
function CheckBaddies(){
  this.tBaddy = testcompu(this.boom.x+1.5,this.boom.y+2);
  if (this.tBaddy >= 0)
    hitcompu this.tBaddy,1,this.boom.x+1.5,this.boom.y+2;
}

NPCEND

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_bootQuest/boot-boss-concept__000__27_20.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/bootQuest/boot-boss-concept.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 27 20
// image: -
// tile: 27,20
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 1d6c9ebdffdb

NPC - 27 20
//NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  showcharacter;
  dir = 2;
  //

  this.speed = 0.5;
  this.chargeSpeed = 1;

  this.mode_Lineup = 0;
  this.mode_Charge = 1;
  this.mode_Stunned = 2;

  this.stunTime = 2;
  this.stunTimer = 0;

  timeout = 0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  this.dists = {playerx-x,playery-y};

  if (this.mode == this.mode_Lineup){//LOOKING
    message Hang on a tick;
    setcharani walk,;
    if (abs(this.dists[0]) > abs(this.dists[1])){
      this.distTo = this.dists[1];
      this.moveDir = 1+this.dists[1]/abs(this.dists[1]);
    }
    else {
      this.distTo = this.dists[0];
      this.moveDir = 2+this.dists[0]/abs(this.dists[0]);
    }

    if (abs(this.distTo) < this.speed){
      this.chargeDir = getdir(this.dists[0],this.dists[1]);
      dir = this.chargeDir;
      this.mode = this.mode_Charge;
    }

    else {
      dir = this.moveDir;
      x += vecx(this.moveDir)*this.speed;
      y += vecy(this.moveDir)*this.speed;
    }
  }

  else if (this.mode == this.mode_Charge){//CHARGE
    message Hold still while I kill you please!;
    setcharani ph_sword-run,;
    if (!onwall(x+1.5+vecx(this.chargeDir)*2,y+2+vecy(this.chargeDir)*2)){
      x += vecx(this.chargeDir)*this.chargeSpeed;
      y += vecy(this.chargeDir)*this.chargeSpeed;
    }
    else {
      this.stunTimer = this.stunTime;
      this.mode = this.mode_Stunned;
    }
  }

  else if (this.mode == this.mode_Stunned){//STUNNED
    setcharani ph_stunned-emote,;
    if (this.stunTimer <= 0){
      this.mode = this.mode_Lineup;
      message ;
    }
    else {
      message ouch, when'd they put a wall there!?;
      this.stunTimer -= 0.05;
    }
  }

  timeout = 0.05;
}

NPCEND

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_bootQuest/quest_plat6__003__31_31.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/bootQuest/quest_plat6.nw
// npc-index: 3
// header: NPC ph_runningboots1.png 31 31
// image: ph_runningboots1.png
// tile: 31,31
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 2ef2fc9d3bb8

NPC ph_runningboots1.png 31 31
//Npc made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  if (!isweapon){
    hide;
    return;
  }

  this.bushTiles = {0x2,0x3,0x12,0x13};
  this.stumpTiles = {0x2A5,0x2A6,0x2B5,0x2B6};

  if (canStrafe)setimg ph_runningboots2.png;
  else setimg ph_runningboots1.png;

  this.speed = 1.3;
  this.speed2 = .2;
  if (keydown(4) && strequals(#w(selectedweapon),Running Boots) && this.wasRunning == 1)run();
}

if (addBoots && !isweapon){
  toweapons Running Boots;
}
if (upgradeBoots){
  setimg ph_runningboots2.png;
  set canStrafe;
}
if (weaponfired){
  disabledefmovement;
  setani walk,;
  sleep 1;
  run();
}
function run(){
  disabledefmovement;
  this.rDir = playerdir;
  this.break = 0;
  while (keydown(4) && this.break == 0){
    this.wasRunning = 1;
    if (keydown(5)){
      this.sword = 1;
      if (!strequals(#m,ph_sword-run))setani ph_sword-run,;
    }
    else {
      this.sword = 0;
      if (!strequals(#m,walk))setani walk,;
    }
    for (this.i=0;this.i<this.speed;this.i+=1/16){
      this.checkC = {playerx+1+vecx(this.rDir)*(0.5+1/16),playery+1.5+vecy(this.rDir)*(0.5+1/16),2,2};
      checkArea();
      if (this.check == 0 && this.break == 0){
        playerx += vecx(this.rDir)*1/16;
        playery += vecy(this.rDir)*1/16;
        this.tNpc = testnpc(playerx+1.5+vecx(this.rDir)*2,playery+2+vecy(this.rDir)*2);
        if (this.tNpc>=0 && this.sword == 1)callnpc this.tNpc,wasBarged,;
        if (this.sword == 1){//bush check
          this.checkC = {int(playerx+0.5)+vecx(this.rDir)*3,playery+1+vecy(this.rDir)*3};
          this.check = true;
          for (this.b = 0;this.b<4;this.b++){
            if (!tiles[this.checkC[0]+(this.b%2),this.checkC[1]+int(this.b/2)] == this.bushTiles[this.b])
              this.check = false;
          }
          if (this.check == true){
            for (this.t = 0;this.t<4;this.t++)tiles[this.checkC[0]+(this.t%2),this.checkC[1]+int(this.t/2)] = this.stumpTiles[this.t];
            updateboard this.checkC[0],this.checkC[1],2,2;
            putleaps 0,this.checkC[0],this.checkC[1];
          }
        }
      }
      else {
        this.break = 1;
        this.i = this.speed;
        sleep .05;
      }
    }
    for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
      if (keydown(this.i) && !vecx(this.i)==vecx(this.rDir) && !onwall(playerx+1.5+vecx(this.i)*2,playery+2+vecy(this.i)*2) && canStrafe){
        playerx += vecx(this.i)*this.speed2;
        playery += vecy(this.i)*this.speed2;
      }
    }
    sleep .05;
  }
  if (this.break == 1){
    setani hurt,;
    for (this.i=0;this.i<8;this.i++){
      setfocus playerx,playery+2+random(-2,2);
      sleep .05;
    }
    resetfocus;
  }
  setani idle,;
  this.wasRunning = 0;
  enabledefmovement;
}
function checkArea(){
  this.check = 0;
  for (this.t=0;this.t<this.checkC[2]*this.checkC[3];this.t++){
    this.tC = {this.checkC[0]+(this.t%this.checkC[2]),this.checkC[1]+int(this.t/this.checkC[2])};
    this.check+=(onwall(this.tC[0],this.tC[1]) || onwater(this.tC[0],this.tC[1]));
  }
}

if (timeout && this.on == 1){
  get_Keys();
  freezeplayer 0.05;
  this.hide = 1;
  for (this.con = 0; this.con < arraylen(this.control); this.con++){
    this.focusIndex = this.control[this.con];
    this.placeC = {this.drawC[0]+(this.focusIndex%this.width)*2,this.drawC[1]+int(this.focusIndex/this.width)*2};
    if (mousex in |this.placeC[0],this.placeC[0]+2| && mousey in |this.placeC[1],this.placeC[1]+2|){
      showimg 300,ph_staff-cursor.gif,this.placeC[0],this.placeC[1];
      this.hide = 0;
      if (leftmousebutton){
        this.realSelect = this.con;
        this.focus[2] = this.placeC[0];
        this.focus[3] = this.placeC[1];
      }
    }
  }
  if (this.hide == 1)hideimg 300;

  showimg 301,ph_staff-cursor.gif,this.focus[2],this.focus[3];

  for (this.i = 0; this.i < 2; this.i++){
    if (this.key[this.i*2+1] == 1){
      this.realSelect = (this.realSelect+vecy(this.i*2))%arraylen(this.control);
      this.focus[2] = this.drawC[0] + (this.control[this.realSelect]%this.width)*2;
      this.focus[3] = this.drawC[1] + int(this.control[this.realSelect]/this.width)*2;
    }
  }

  this.dist = {this.focus[0]-this.focus[2],this.focus[1]-this.focus[3]};
  if ((this.dist[0]^2+this.dist[1]^2)^0.5 > 1){
    this.angle = getangle(-this.dist[0],this.dist[1]);
    this.focus[0] += cos(this.angle)*1;
    this.focus[1] += sin(this.angle)*1;

    setfocus this.focus[0],this.focus[1];
  }

  if (this.key[5] == 1){
    this.select = this.control[this.realSelect];
    this.dir[this.select] = (this.dir[this.select]+1)%4;
    current();
  }

  else if (this.key[6] == 1){
    hideimg 300;
    resetfocus;
    this.on = 0;
  }
  timeout = 0.05;
}

function draw(){
  for (this.c = 0; this.c < arraylen(this.circuit); this.c++){
    this.placeC = {this.drawC[0]-0.5+(this.c%this.width)*2,this.drawC[1]-0.5+int(this.c/this.width)*2};
    if (this.circuit[this.c] == -1)//power
      showimg 302+this.c,plant.png,this.placeC[0]+0.5,this.placeC[1];

    else if (this.circuit[this.c] == -2)
      triggeraction this.placeC[0]+1,this.placeC[1]+1,Current,#v(this.active[this.c]);

    else if (this.circuit[this.c] <= 0)
      hideimg 302+this.c;

    else {
      if (this.select == this.c)setstring this.anim,rotate;
      else setstring this.anim,idle;
      setstring this.gani,ph_circuit-#I(this.type,this.circuit[this.c]-1)-#s(this.anim)-#I(this.state,this.active[this.c]);
      showani 302+this.c,this.placeC[0],this.placeC[1],this.dir[this.c],#s(this.gani),;
      changeimgvis 302+this.c,0;
    }
  }
}

function current(){
  for (this.d = 0; this.d < arraylen(this.active); this.d++)
    this.active[this.d] = 0;

  setstring this.powerOpen,#v(this.power);
  setstring this.powerClosed, ;

  while (sarraylen(this.powerOpen) > 0){
    this.openSize = sarraylen(this.powerOpen);
    for (this.p = 0; this.p < this.openSize; this.p++){
      this.realIndex = strtofloat(#I(this.powerOpen,0));//index of the target element
      this.active[this.realIndex] = 1;

      addstring this.powerClosed,#I(this.powerOpen,0);//add the element to the closed array so it's not chosen again
      deletestring this.powerOpen,0;//remove the element from the open array

      this.targetIndex = this.realIndex;
      getFlow();
      this.illegalDirections = this.tempDirections;

      for (this.d = 0; this.d < 4; this.d++){
        if (this.d in this.illegalDirections && (this.circuit[this.realIndex] > 0 || this.circuit[this.realIndex] == -1) || this.circuit[this.realIndex] == -2){
          continue;
        }
        this.targetIndex = this.realIndex+vecx(this.d)+vecy(this.d)*this.width;
        getFlow();
        if ((this.circuit[this.targetIndex] > 0 || this.circuit[this.targetIndex] == -2) &&//check that it's actually a valid component
          lindexof(#v(this.targetIndex),this.powerClosed) < 0 && lindexof(#v(this.targetIndex),this.powerOpen) < 0 &&//check if it's not in an array
          !(((this.d+2)%4) in this.tempDirections)//check the circuitry lines up
        )
          addstring this.powerOpen,#v(this.targetIndex);
      }
    }
  }
  draw();
}

function get_Keys(){
  for (this.keyCheck = 0;this.keyCheck < 10; this.keyCheck++){
    if (keydown(this.keyCheck))
      this.key[this.keyCheck] = (this.key[this.keyCheck] == 0)?1:2;//1 = pressed,2 = held
    else
      this.key[this.keyCheck] = (this.key[this.keyCheck]>0)?-1:0;//-1 = released, 0 = not held
  }
}

function getFlow(){//get illegal directions
  this.targetType = this.circuit[this.targetIndex];
  if (this.targetType == 1)//straight
    this.tempDirections = {this.dir[this.targetIndex]+1,(this.dir[this.targetIndex]+3)%4};
  else if (this.targetType == 2)//corner
    this.tempDirections = {(this.dir[this.targetIndex]+1)%4,(this.dir[this.targetIndex]+2)%4};
  else if (this.targetType = 3)//intersect
    this.tempDirections = {(this.dir[this.targetIndex]+2)%4};
  //else if (this.targetType == -1)//power
   // this.tempDirections = {0,1,3};
  else
    this.tempDirections = {-1};
}

// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/cloudrest_quest/cloud_warp_dungeon0.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 17 38
// image: -
// tile: 17,38
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: e977921927a6

NPC - 17 38
// NPC made by Tricxta
if (playerenters){
  timereverywhere;
  this.slidetiles={0xEBF};
  this.maxslidespeed=1;
  this.speedgain=.05;
  this.friction=.025;
  timeout=.05;
}

if (timeout){
  this.ontile=0;
  this.keydown=0;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++)this.ontile+=(tiles[playerx+1+(this.i%2),playery+1+int(this.i/2)] in this.slidetiles);
  if (this.ontile==4){
    disabledefmovement;
    for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
      if (keydown(this.i)){
        playerdir=this.i;
        this.keydown=1;
        if (abs(this.speedx)<this.maxslidespeed)this.speedx+=vecx(this.i)*(this.speedgain);
        if (abs(this.speedy)<this.maxslidespeed)this.speedy+=vecy(this.i)*(this.speedgain);
      }
    }
    if (abs(this.speedx)>0)this.speedx+=(this.speedx<0)?this.friction:this.friction*-1;
    if (abs(this.speedy)>0)this.speedy+=(this.speedy<0)?this.friction:this.friction*-1;
    this.onwall=0;
    this.startx=(this.speedx!=0)?(abs(this.speedx)/this.speedx)*2:0;
    this.starty=(this.speedy!=0)?(abs(this.speedy)/this.speedy)*2:0;
    scan();
    if (this.onwall>0)this.push++;
    else this.push=0;
    if (this.speedx!=0){
      this.startx=abs(this.speedx)/this.speedx;
      this.starty=.5;
      scan();
    }
    if (this.speedy!=0){
      this.startx=0;
      this.starty=abs(this.speedy)/this.speedy;
      scan();
    }
    if (this.onwall==0){
      playerx+=this.speedx;
      playery+=this.speedy;
    }
    else stop();
    if (this.keydown==1){
      if (this.push>=20)setani push,;
      else setani walk,;
    }
    else setani idle,;
  }
  else stop();
  timeout=0.05;
}

function stop(){
  enabledefmovement;
  this.speedx=0;
  this.speedy=0;
}

function scan(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++){
    if (onwall(int(playerx+.5+this.startx+(this.i%2)),int(playery+1+this.starty+int(this.i/2)))){this.onwall=1;break}
  }
}

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_cloudrest_quest/cloud_warp_dungeon1__001__46_38.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/cloudrest_quest/cloud_warp_dungeon1.nw
// npc-index: 1
// header: NPC - 46 38
// image: -
// tile: 46,38
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: b699766c48de

NPC - 46 38
// NPC made by Tricxta
if (playerenters){
  noplayerkilling;
  timereverywhere;

  this.playerSize = {2,2};
  this.playerOffset = {0.5,1};

  this.slideTiles={0xEBF};
  this.maxSlideSpeed=0.8;
  this.speedGain=.05;
  this.friction=.025;
  this.wallImpact = 1/3;//speed percentage after hitting a wall

  this.pushTimer = 2;

  timeout=.05;
}

if (timeout){
  this.didMove = false;
  this.moveComponent = {0,0};

  this.checkC = {playerx+this.playerOffset[0],playery+this.playerOffset[1]};  checkBlock();
  if (this.tileCount > 0){
    freezeplayer 0.05;

    for (this.k = 0; this.k < 4; this.k++){
      if (keydown(this.k)){

        //skip checking for any more inputs on this axis if one is already provided
        if (this.moveComponent[abs(vecy(this.k))] == 1)continue;

        playerdir = this.k;
        this.didMove = true;

        this.moveComponent[abs(vecy(this.k))] = 1;
        this.dX = max(this.maxSlideSpeed*-1,min(this.maxSlideSpeed,this.dX+this.speedGain*vecx(this.k)));
        this.dY = max(this.maxSlideSpeed*-1,min(this.maxSlideSpeed,this.dY+this.speedGain*vecy(this.k)));
      }
    }

    this.checkC = {playerx+this.playerOffset[0]+this.dX,playery+this.playerOffset[1]};  checkBlock();
    if (this.wallCount == 0)playerx += this.dX;
    else this.dX *= this.wallImpact*-1;

    this.checkC = {playerx+this.playerOffset[0],playery+this.playerOffset[1]+this.dY};  checkBlock();
    if (this.wallCount == 0)playery += this.dY;
    else this.dY *= this.wallImpact*1;

    //let friction play its role
    if (this.moveComponent[0] == 0){
      this.dX -= (this.dX/abs(this.dX))*this.friction;
      if (abs(this.dX) <= this.friction)
        this.dX = 0;
    }
    if (this.moveComponent[1] == 0){
      this.dY -= (this.dY/abs(this.dY))*this.friction;
      if (abs(this.dY) <= this.friction)
        this.dY = 0;
    }

    //pushing
    if ((this.moveComponent[0] > 0 && abs(this.dX) <= this.speedGain) || (this.moveComponent[1] > 0 && abs(this.dY) <= this.speedGain)){
      this.pushCount += 0.05;
    }
    else this.pushCount = 0;

    if (this.didMove == false){
      setani idle,;
    }
    else {
      if (this.pushCount >= this.pushTimer-0.5){
        setani push,;
        //create a delay between trigger and gani set
        if (this.pushCount >= this.pushTimer)push();
      }

      else
        setani walk,;
    }
  }
  else {
    this.dX = 0;
    this.dY = 0;
    if (strequals(#m,push)){
      this.pushCount += 0.05;
      if (this.pushCount >= this.pushTimer - 1.5)push();
    }
    else this.pushCount = 0;
  }

  timeout = 0.05;
}

function checkBlock(){
  this.wallCount = 0;  this.tileCount = 0;
  for (this.w = 0; this.w < this.playerSize[0]*this.playerSize[1]; this.w++){
    this.tileC = {int(this.checkC[0]+(this.w%this.playerSize[0])+0.5),int(this.checkC[1]+int(this.w/this.playerSize[0])+0.5)};

    this.wallCount += (onwall(this.tileC[0],this.tileC[1]));
    this.tileCount += (tiles[this.tileC[0],this.tileC[1]] in this.slideTiles);
  }
}

function push(){
  for (this.n =0; this.n < npcscount; this.n++){
    this.npcC = {npcs[this.n].x+npcs[this.n].width/2,npcs[this.n].y+npcs[this.n].height/2};
    if ((this.npcC[0]-(playerx+this.playerOffset[0]+vecx(playerdir))) in |0,2| && (this.npcC[1]-(playery+this.playerOffset[1]+vecy(playerdir))) in |0,2|){
      callnpc this.n,wasPushed,;
      this.n = npcscount;
    }
  }
}

NPCEND

// npc-index: 34
// header: NPC ce_lift-snowbush.png 49 37
// image: ce_lift-snowbush.png
// tile: 49,37
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 46ee57421577

NPC ce_lift-snowbush.png 49 37
// NPC made by Tricxta
if (playerenters){
  level.door=0;
this.placed=0;
  setshape 1,32,32;
  this.slidetiles={0xEBF,0x6EA,0x6EB,0x6FA,0x6FB};
  this.target={0x6EA,0x6EB,0x6FA,0x6FB};
  check();
}
if (playertouchsme){
  this.checkx=x-1.5+(vecx((playerdir+2)%4)*2);
  this.checky=y-1.5+(vecy((playerdir+2)%4)*2);
  while (playerx in |this.checkx,this.checkx+2| && playery in |this.checky,this.checky+2|){
    if (strequals(#m,push)){this.sdir=playerdir;slide();break;}
    sleep .05;
  }
}

function slide(){
  this.check=4;
  while (this.check==4){
    this.check=0;
    for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++)this.check+=((tiles[x+vecx(this.sdir)+(this.i%2),y+vecy(this.sdir)+int(this.i/2)] in this.slidetiles) && (!onwall(x+vecx(this.sdir)+(this.i%2),y+vecy(this.sdir)+int(this.i/2))));
    if (this.check==4){
      x+=vecx(this.sdir);
      y+=vecy(this.sdir);
    }
    sleep .05;
  }
  check();
}

function check(){
  this.tiles=0;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++)this.tiles+=(tiles[x+(this.i%2),y+int(this.i/2)] in this.target);
  if (this.tiles==4 && this.placed==0){
    this.placed=1;
    level.door++;
    sleep 1;
  }
  else if (this.tiles<4 && this.placed==1){
    this.placed=0;
    level.door--;
    sleep 1;
  }
}

if (playerchats && strequals(#c,reset)){
  x=30;
  y=37;
  level.door=0;
}

if (playerchats && strequals(#c,634)){

  level.door=4;
}

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_cloudrest_quest/push-quest_door__000__0_0.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/cloudrest_quest/push-quest_door.txt
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 0 0
// image: -
// tile: 0,0
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: b421a4cc2dad

NPC - 0 0
// NPC made by Tricxta
if (playerenters){
  timereverywhere;
  setshape 1,32,48;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  getCheck();

  if (this.target == this.triggerCount){
    this.open = min(1,this.open+0.05);
    dontblock;
  }
  else {
    this.open = max(0,this.open-0.05);
    blockagain;
  }

  showimg 300,ph_ice-door.png,x,y;
  changeimgpart 300,16,64+this.open*32,32,48-this.open*32;
  changeimgvis 300,0;

  timeout = 0.05;
}

function getCheck(){
  this.triggerCount = arraylen(this.trigger)/2;
  this.target = 0;
  for (this.p =0; this.p < this.triggerCount; this.p++){
    for (this.n = 0; this.n < npcscount; this.n++){
      this.target += (npcs[this.n].x == this.trigger[this.p*2] && npcs[this.n].y == this.trigger[this.p*2+1] && strequals(#f(this.n),#s(this.img)));
	}
  }
}

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_cloudrest_quest/push-quest_movement__000__0_0.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/cloudrest_quest/push-quest_movement.txt
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 0 0
// image: -
// tile: 0,0
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 74f4a04d6689

NPC - 0 0
// NPC made by Tricxta
if (playerenters){
  timereverywhere;
  
  if (this.pushTimer <= 0)this.pushTimer = 2;
  
  timeout=.05;
}

if (timeout){
  this.didMove = false;
  this.moveComponent = {0,0};

  this.checkC = {playerx+this.playerOffset[0],playery+this.playerOffset[1]};  checkBlock();
  if (this.tileCount > 0){
    freezeplayer 0.05;

    for (this.k = 0; this.k < 4; this.k++){
      if (keydown(this.k)){

        //skip checking for any more inputs on this axis if one is already provided
        if (this.moveComponent[abs(vecy(this.k))] == 1)continue;

        playerdir = this.k;
        this.didMove = true;

        this.moveComponent[abs(vecy(this.k))] = 1;
        this.dX = max(this.maxSlideSpeed*-1,min(this.maxSlideSpeed,this.dX+this.speedGain*vecx(this.k)));
        this.dY = max(this.maxSlideSpeed*-1,min(this.maxSlideSpeed,this.dY+this.speedGain*vecy(this.k)));
      }
    }

    this.checkC = {playerx+this.playerOffset[0]+this.dX,playery+this.playerOffset[1]};  checkBlock();
    if (this.wallCount == 0)playerx += this.dX;
    else this.dX *= this.wallImpact*-1;

    this.checkC = {playerx+this.playerOffset[0],playery+this.playerOffset[1]+this.dY};  checkBlock();
    if (this.wallCount == 0)playery += this.dY;
    else this.dY *= this.wallImpact*1;

    //let friction play its role
    if (this.moveComponent[0] == 0){
      this.dX -= (this.dX/abs(this.dX))*this.friction;
      if (abs(this.dX) <= this.friction)
        this.dX = 0;
    }
    if (this.moveComponent[1] == 0){
      this.dY -= (this.dY/abs(this.dY))*this.friction;
      if (abs(this.dY) <= this.friction)
        this.dY = 0;
    }

    //pushing
    if ((this.moveComponent[0] > 0 && abs(this.dX) <= this.speedGain) || (this.moveComponent[1] > 0 && abs(this.dY) <= this.speedGain)){
      this.pushCount += 0.05;
    }
    else this.pushCount = 0;

    if (this.didMove == false){
      setani idle,;
    }
    else {
      if (this.pushCount >= this.pushTimer-0.5){
        setani push,;
        //create a delay between trigger and gani set
        if (this.pushCount >= this.pushTimer)push();
      }

      else
        setani walk,;
    }
  }
  else {
    this.dX = 0;
    this.dY = 0;
    if (strequals(#m,push)){
      this.pushCount += 0.05;
      if (this.pushCount >= this.pushTimer - 1.5)push();
    }
    else this.pushCount = 0;
  }

  timeout = 0.05;
}

function checkBlock(){
  this.wallCount = 0;  this.tileCount = 0;
  for (this.w = 0; this.w < this.playerSize[0]*this.playerSize[1]; this.w++){
    this.tileC = {int(this.checkC[0]+(this.w%this.playerSize[0])+0.5),int(this.checkC[1]+int(this.w/this.playerSize[0])+0.5)};

    this.wallCount += (onwall(this.tileC[0],this.tileC[1]));
    this.tileCount += (tiles[this.tileC[0],this.tileC[1]] in this.slideTiles);
  }
}

function push(){
  for (this.n =0; this.n < npcscount; this.n++){
    this.npcC = {npcs[this.n].x+npcs[this.n].width/2,npcs[this.n].y+npcs[this.n].height/2};
    if ((this.npcC[0]-(playerx+this.playerOffset[0]+vecx(playerdir))) in |0,2| && (this.npcC[1]-(playery+this.playerOffset[1]+vecy(playerdir))) in |0,2|){
      callnpc this.n,wasPushed,;
      this.n = npcscount;
    }
  }
}

NPCEND

    this.check=0;
    for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++)this.check+=((tiles[x+vecx(this.sdir)+(this.i%2),y+vecy(this.sdir)+int(this.i/2)] in this.slidetiles) && (!onwall(x+vecx(this.sdir)+(this.i%2),y+vecy(this.sdir)+int(this.i/2))));

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_cr-mini_game/cr_game_lobby__049__32_10.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/cr-mini game/cr_game_lobby.nw
// npc-index: 49
// header: NPC - 32 10
// image: -
// tile: 32,10
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 2f10c37bab7b

NPC - 32 10
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  timereverywhere;
  this.playersneeded=1;
}

if (playerchats && strequals(#c,Start) && strtofloat(#s(server.crgame))==0){
  check();
  if (this.count>=this.playersneeded)startgame();
  else reject();
}

function check(){
  this.count=0;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<playerscount;this.i++){
    if (strequals(#c(this.i),Ready) || strequals(#c(this.i),Start))this.count++;
  }
}

function startgame(){
  for (this.i=10;this.i>0;this.i--){
    message Time left to join:#v(this.i);
    sleep 1;
  }
  check();
  if (this.count>=this.playersneeded){
    setstring server.crgame,1;
    for (this.i=0;this.i<playerscount;this.i++){
      if (strequals(#c(this.i),Ready) || strequals(#c(this.i),Start)){
        this.count=(this.count+1%3);
        if (this.count==0)triggeraction players[this.i].x+1,players[this.i].y+1,Cop,#a(this.i);
        else triggeraction players[this.i].x+1,players[this.i].y+1,Robber,#a(this.i);
      }
    }
  }
  else reject();
}

function reject(){
  message Sorry, there are not enough players to start playing.;
  sleep 3;
  message;
}

NPCEND

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_dancing/dancing__000__27_37.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/dancing/dancing.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 27 37
// image: -
// tile: 27,37
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 15a17cf6510c

NPC - 27 37
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  setarray this.key,10;
  this.keyLength = 4;

  setstring this.dances,//gani,code sequence
    at_dance,3310,
      era_dance001,1313;

  setstring this.arrows,ph_arrows.png;
  setstring this.codeIn,;
}

if (keypressed && strequals(#p(1),w)){
  freezeplayer 0.05;
  setani idle,;
  hideimgs 300,305;
  this.on = (this.on+1)%2;;
  timeout = 0.05;
}

if (timeout && this.on == 1){
  freezeplayer 0.05;
  get_Keys();

  for (this.k = 0; this.k < 4; this.k++){
    if (this.key[this.k] == 1){
      play ph_cursor.wav;
      setstring this.codeIn,#s(this.codeIn)#v(this.k);
      draw_Arrows();
    }
  }

  if (strlen(#s(this.codeIn)) >= this.keyLength){
    sleep 0.1;
    get_Dance();
  }

  timeout = 0.05;
}

function draw_Arrows(){
  hideimgs 300,305;
  for (this.i = 0; this.i < strlen(#s(this.codeIn)); this.i++){
    this.drawC = {screenwidth/2-66*2+this.i*66,screenheight/2-33};

    showimg 300+this.i,#s(this.arrows),this.drawC[0],this.drawC[1];
    changeimgpart 300+this.i,strtofloat(#e(this.i,1,#s(this.codeIn)))*66,(this.i < strlen(#s(this.codeIn))-1)*66,66,66;
    changeimgvis 300+this.i,4;
  }
}

function get_Dance(){
  this.dInd = lindexof(#s(this.codeIn),this.dances);
  if (this.dInd >= 0){
    setani #I(this.dances,this.dInd-1),;
  }
  else {
    play ph_exit.wav;
    setani sit,;
  }

  setstring this.codeIn,;
  hideimgs 300,305;
}


function get_Keys(){
  for (this.k = 0; this.k < 10; this.k++){
    if (keydown(this.k))
      this.key[this.k] = (this.key[this.k] > 0)?2:1;
    else
      this.key[this.k] = (this.key[this.k] > 0)?-1:0;
  }
}

        this.vecX = -cos(this.bAng[this.b]);
        this.vecY = -sin(this.bAng[this.b]);
        this.bAng[this.b] = getangle(this.vecX,this.vecY);
      }
      if (this.boundCheck[1] <= this.boundY[0] || this.boundCheck[1] >=  this.boundY[1]){
        this.vecX = cos(this.bAng[this.b]);
        this.vecY = sin(this.bAng[this.b]);

      }
    }
  }

  setstring this.leveldest,waterlevels.nw;
  this.radius=13;
  this.speed=.04;
  this.suction=0.1;
  this.angle=-1;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout){
  if (playerx in |x-this.radius,x+this.radius| && playery in |y-this.radius,y+this.radius| && playerswimming){
    this.dist=(((playerx-x)^2)+((playery-y)^2))^.5;
    if (this.angle==-1){
      this.angle=arctan((playery-y)/(playerx-x));
      //if (playerx<x)this.angle+=(pi);
    }
    else this.angle+=this.speed%(pi*2);
    playerx = x+cos(this.angle)*(this.dist-this.suction);
    playery = y+sin(this.angle)*(this.dist-this.suction);
  }
  if (this.dist<=1.4 && playerswimming)setlevel #s(this.leveldest);
  timeout=0.05;

    updateboard x,y,4,5;

    level.waterfall=0;
    hide;

  timeout=0.05;

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_dungeon2_water/waterlevels__001__25_26.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/dungeon2(water)/waterlevels.nw
// npc-index: 1
// header: NPC block.png 25 26
// image: block.png
// tile: 25,26
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: d4f6481a0223

NPC block.png 25 26
// NPC made by *Tricxta
if (playerenters){
  message hit me;
  //change this to the position of the water outlet
  this.originx=16;
  this.originy=41;
  this.range=10;//remember to change this!
  this.maxradius=0;//dont touch this

  setarray this.overwritten,4096;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4096;this.i++)this.overwritten[this.i]=-1;//this is to record the tiles that are changed

  this.converttiles={//tiles the will be turned into water tiles
    0x12D,0x8,0xF,0xAA,0xAB,0xD8E,0xDBE,0xD9E,0xDCE,0xDAE,
    0xD8F,0xF80,0xD9F,0xF90,0xD8C,0xD8D,0xD9C,0xD9D,0xDAC,
    0xDAD,0xDBC,0xDBD,0xDCC,0xDCD,0x35A,0x35B
  };

  this.watertiles={0x142,0x142,0x142,0x142,0x142,0x152};

  //remember the level before any changes are made
  setarray this.levelrecord,4096;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<4096;this.i++)this.levelrecord[this.i]=tiles[this.i%64,int(this.i/64)];
}
if (washit){
  if (this.complete==0){
    flood();
    this.complete=1;
  }
  else if (this.complete==1){
    restore();
    this.complete=0;
  }
}

function flood(){
  for (this.radius=0;this.radius<this.range;this.radius++){
    for (this.angle=0;this.angle<(pi*2);this.angle+=.01){
      this.checkx=this.originx+int(cos(this.angle)*this.radius);
      this.checky=this.originy+int(sin(this.angle)*this.radius);

      //checking to see if there is any water around
      this.watercheck=0;
      for (this.i=0;this.i<4;this.i++)
        this.watercheck+=(tiles[this.checkx+vecx(this.i),this.checky+vecy(this.i)] in this.watertiles);

      if (tiles[this.checkx,this.checky] in this.converttiles && (this.watercheck>0 || this.radius==0)){
        tiles[this.checkx,this.checky]=this.watertiles[int(random(0,arraylen(this.watertiles)))];
        this.overwritten[(this.checky*64)+this.checkx]=1;
        updateboard this.checkx,this.checky,1,1;
        this.maxradius=this.radius;
      }
    }
    sleep .05;
  }
}

function restore(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<npcscount;this.i++)callnpc this.i,restore,;
  for (this.radius=this.maxradius;this.radius>=0;this.radius--){
    for (this.angle=0;this.angle<=pi*2;this.angle+=.01){
      this.checkx=this.originx+int(cos(this.angle)*this.radius);
      this.checky=this.originy+int(sin(this.angle)*this.radius);
      if (this.overwritten[(this.checky*64)+this.checkx]==1){
        tiles[this.checkx,this.checky]=this.levelrecord[this.checkx+(this.checky*64)];
        updateboard this.checkx,this.checky,1,1;
      }
    }
    sleep .05;
  }
}

NPCEND

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_dungeon2_water/whirlpool__000__30_40.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/dungeon2(water)/whirlpool.nw
// npc-index: 0
// header: NPC - 30 40
// image: -
// tile: 30,40
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 1ba17c8926e1

NPC - 30 40
// NPC made by Tricxta
if (playerenters){
  this.radius=13;
  setstring this.plug,block;
  this.plugsneeded=2;
  this.plugs=0;
  this.speed=.04;
  this.suction=0.1;
  setarray this.npcangle,npcscount;
  for (this.i=0;this.i<npcscount;this.i++)this.npcangle[this.i]=-1;
  level.blocked=0;
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (timeout && level.blocked==0){
  for (this.i=1;this.i<npcscount;this.i++){
    checkwater();
    if (npcs[this.i].x in |x-this.radius,y+this.radius| && npcs[this.i].y in |y-this.radius,y+this.radius| && this.check>0){
      this.dist=(((npcs[this.i].x-x)^2)+((npcs[this.i].y-y)^2))^.5;
      if (this.npcangle[this.i]==-1){
        this.npcangle[this.i]=arctan((npcs[this.i].y-y)/(npcs[this.i].x-x));
        if (npcs[this.i].x<x)this.npcangle[this.i]+=(pi/2);
        if (npcs[this.i].x<x)this.npcangle[this.i]+=(pi/2);
      }
      else this.npcangle[this.i]+=this.speed%(pi*2);
      npcs[this.i].x= x+cos(this.npcangle[this.i])*(this.dist-this.suction);
      npcs[this.i].y= y+sin(this.npcangle[this.i])*(this.dist-this.suction);
    }
  }
  draw();
  timeout=0.05;
}

if (stop){
  if (strequals(#p(0),#s(this.plug)))this.plugs++;
  if (this.plugs>=this.plugsneeded){
    level.blocked=1;
    hideimgs 0,(this.radius/this.step);
    break;
  }
}

function checkwater(){
  this.check=0;
  for (this.a=0;this.a<(npcs[this.i].width*npcs[this.i].height);this.a++)this.check+=onwater(npcs[this.i].x+(this.a%npcs[this.i].width),npcs[this.i].y+int(this.a/npcs[this.i].width));
}

function draw(){
  this.temp.radius=0;
  this.step=.35;
  this.start.angle+=this.step%(pi*2);
  this.temp.angle=this.start.angle;
  this.linecount=0;
  while (this.temp.radius<this.radius){
    this.temp.angle+=this.step%(pi*2);
    this.temp.radius+=this.step;
    showpoly this.linecount,{x+cos(this.temp.angle)*this.temp.radius,y+sin(this.temp.angle)*this.temp.radius,x+cos(this.temp.angle+this.step)*(this.temp.radius+this.step),y+sin(this.temp.angle+this.step)*(this.temp.radius+this.step)};
    this.linecount++;
  }
}

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_dungeon3_forest/art_warp_dungeon4__003__32_5.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/dungeon3(forest)/art_warp_dungeon4.nw
// npc-index: 3
// header: NPC - 32 5
// image: -
// tile: 32,5
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: 59fe682bc417

NPC - 32 5
// NPC made by tricxta
if (playerenters){
  this.recorded=0;
  this.bridgelength=15;
  this.bridgetiles={0xD6B,0x20,0x8AA,0x8A9,0xEBF,0xEBF,0xEBF,0xEBF,0xEBF,0xEBF,0xEBF,0xEBF};
  setarray this.replacedtiles,this.bridgelength*7;
}

if (call3){
  this.on=1-this.on;
  if (this.on==1)open();
  else close();
}

function open(){
  for (this.i=0;this.i<this.bridgelength;this.i++){
    for (this.t=0;this.t<7;this.t++){
      if (this.recorded==0)this.replacedtiles[(this.i*7)+this.t]=tiles[x+this.t,y+this.i];
      tiles[x+this.t,y+this.i]=(this.t%6==0)?this.bridgetiles[this.i%2]:this.bridgetiles[int(random(0,9)+2.5)];
    }
    updateboard x,y+this.i,7,2;
    sleep .1;
  }
  this.recorded=1;
}

function close(){
  for (this.i=this.bridgelength-1;this.i>0;this.i--){
    for (this.t=0;this.t<7;this.t++)tiles[x+this.t,y+this.i]=this.replacedtiles[(this.i*7)+this.t];
    updateboard x,y+this.i,7,2;
    sleep .1;
  }
}

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_dungeon3_forest/ph_dungeon3-2__001__45_27.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/dungeon3(forest)/ph_dungeon3-2.nw
// npc-index: 1
// header: NPC - 45 27
// image: -
// tile: 45,27
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: ba029c0466f7

NPC - 45 27
//Made by tricxta
if (triggered) {
  // Initialize the attributes
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #3,head72.png;
  setcharprop #C0,orange;
  setcharprop #C1,black;
  setcharprop #C2,gray;
  setcharprop #C3,red;
  setcharprop #C4,black;
  setcharprop #2,no-shield.png;
  shieldpower = 1;
  dir = 1;
  swordpower = 1;
  hurtdx = 0;
  hurtdy = 0;
  hearts = 3;
  // Initialize the this. variables
  message;
  this.huntspeed = 0.4;
  timeout = 0.05;
  if (hearts<=0) {
    this.mode = 5; // RESPAWN
    this.runcounter = 0;
    timeout = 5;
  } else {
    this.mode = 2;
    setcharani idle,;
    this.runcounter = int(random(10,40));
  }
}

// Sword attacking stuff
if (timeout && (this.mode==0 || this.mode==2)) {
  // Look for players
  mindist = 1000;
  for (i=0; i<playerscount; i++)
    if (players[i].hearts>0 && players[i].id>=0) {
    dx = players[i].x - x;
    dy = players[i].y - y;
    if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) {
      if (dx>0) pdir=3; else pdir=1;
    } else {
      if (dy>0) pdir=2; else pdir=0;
    }
    if (pdir==dir) {
      dist = (dx*dx+dy*dy)^0.5;
      if (dist<mindist) {
        cansee = 1;
        if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) k = int(abs(dx));
        else k = int(abs(dy));
        for (j=0; j<=k-2; j++)
          if (onwall(x+1.5+dx*j/k,y+2+dy*j/k)) cansee = 0;
        if (cansee!=0) {
          mindist = dist;
          aimplayer = i;
          this.aimx = players[i].x;
          this.aimy = players[i].y;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if (mindist<=3) {
    this.runcounter = -1;
    this.mode = 3; // SLAYING
    setcharani sword,;
    timeout = 0.05;
  } else if (mindist<20) {
    if (this.mode!=2) message Stop!;
    this.runcounter = 100;
    this.mode = 2; // HUNTING
  } else timeout = 0.05;
}
if (timeout && this.mode==3) { // SLAYING
  this.runcounter++;
  if (this.runcounter>4) {
    this.runcounter = 100;
    this.mode = 2; // HUNTING
    setcharani idle,;
  }
  message;
  timeout = 0.05;
}
if (timeout && this.mode==2) { // HUNTING
  setcharani walk,;
  this.runcounter--;
  if (this.runcounter>0 && aimplayer<playerscount && players[aimplayer].hearts>0) {
    // Get new direction
    dx = players[aimplayer].x-x;
    dy = players[aimplayer].y-y;
    if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) {
      if (dx>0) dir=3; else dir=1;
    } else {
      if (dy>0) dir=2; else dir=0;
    }

    // Test if we can do a step
    dx = this.aimx-x;
    dy = this.aimy-y;
    if (abs(dx)<=1 && abs(dy)<=1) {
      this.aimx = players[aimplayer].x;;
      this.aimy = players[aimplayer].y;
      dx = this.aimx-x;
      dy = this.aimy-y;
    }
    if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) {
      if (dx>0) testdir=3; else testdir=1;
    } else {
      if (dy>0) testdir=2; else testdir=0;
    }
    len = (dx*dx+dy*dy)^0.5;
    addx = (dx/len)*this.huntspeed;
    addy = (dy/len)*this.huntspeed;
    testx = x + 1.5;
    testy = y + 2;
    if (!onwall(testx+addx,testy+addy)) {
      // Do a step
      x += addx;
      y += addy;
    } else if (!onwall(testx+addx,testy)) x += addx;
    else if (!onwall(testx,testy+addy)) y += addy;
  } else {
    this.mode = 0; // WALKING
    this.walkmode = 1; // RANDOM
    this.runcounter = int(random(10,40));
    setcharani idle,;
    dir = (dir+2)%4;
    message;
  }
  timeout = 0.05;
}

// Hurting stuff
if (washit && this.mode!=1 && hearts>0) {
  dx = x-playerx;
  dy = y-playery;
  len = (dx*dx+dy*dy)^0.5;
  hurtdx = dx/len;
  hurtdy = dy/len;
  setcharani hurt,;
  hideimg 1;
  hearts -= playerswordpower/2;
}
if ((exploded || waspelt || wasshot) &&
  this.mode!=1 && hearts>0 && isleader) {
  hurtdx = -vecx(dir)*0.2;
  hurtdy = -vecy(dir)*0.2;
  setcharani hurt,;
  if (peltwithsign || peltwithvase || peltwithstone || peltwithnpc) hearts -= 1;
  else if (peltwithblackstone) hearts -= 1.5;
  else hearts -= 0.5;
}
if ((hurtdx!=0 || hurtdy!=0) && isleader && this.mode!=4) {
  this.hurtdx = hurtdx;
  this.hurtdy = hurtdy;
  hurtdx = 0;
  hurtdy = 0;
  if (hearts<=0) {
    this.mode = 4; // DYING
    message;
    setcharani dead,;
    timeout = 1.2;
  } else {
    this.mode = 1; // HURTED
    this.runcounter = 20;
    setcharani hurt,;
    timeout = 0.05;
  }
}
if (timeout && this.mode==1) { // HURTED
  this.runcounter--;
  if (this.runcounter>10) {
    testx = x + 1.5 + this.hurtdx*2;
    testy = y + 2 + this.hurtdy*2;
    if (!onwall(testx,testy)) {
      x += this.hurtdx;
      y += this.hurtdy;
    }
  }
  if (this.runcounter<=0) {
    if (swordpower>0) this.mode = 2; // HUNTING
    else this.mode = 0; // WALKING
    this.runcounter = 100;
    setcharani idle,;
  }
  timeout = 0.05;
}
if (timeout && this.mode==4) { // DYING
  destroy;
}

// ===== 02_phoenix/PhoenixNPC_Phoenix_dungeon3_forest/ph_dungeon3-2__003__16_21.npc.txt =====
// extracted-from: PhoenixNPC/Phoenix/dungeon3(forest)/ph_dungeon3-2.nw
// npc-index: 3
// header: NPC - 16 21
// image: -
// tile: 16,21
// recovered-from-binary: false
// body-hash: f7f90daf31b2

NPC - 16 21
//Made by tricxta
if (triggered) {
  // Initialize the attributes
  showcharacter;
  setcharprop #3,head72.png;
  setcharprop #C0,orange;
  setcharprop #C1,black;
  setcharprop #C2,gray;
  setcharprop #C3,red;
  setcharprop #C4,black;
  setcharprop #2,no-shield.png;
  shieldpower = 1;
  dir = 3;
  swordpower = 1;
  hurtdx = 0;
  hurtdy = 0;
  hearts = 3;
  // Initialize the this. variables
  message;
  this.huntspeed = 0.4;
  timeout = 0.05;
  if (hearts<=0) {
    this.mode = 5; // RESPAWN
    this.runcounter = 0;
    timeout = 5;
  } else {
    this.mode = 2;
    setcharani idle,;
    this.runcounter = int(random(10,40));
  }
}

// Sword attacking stuff
if (timeout && (this.mode==0 || this.mode==2)) {
  // Look for players
  mindist = 1000;
  for (i=0; i<playerscount; i++)
    if (players[i].hearts>0 && players[i].id>=0) {
    dx = players[i].x - x;
    dy = players[i].y - y;
    if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) {
      if (dx>0) pdir=3; else pdir=1;
    } else {
      if (dy>0) pdir=2; else pdir=0;
    }
    if (pdir==dir) {
      dist = (dx*dx+dy*dy)^0.5;
      if (dist<mindist) {
        cansee = 1;
        if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) k = int(abs(dx));
        else k = int(abs(dy));
        for (j=0; j<=k-2; j++)
          if (onwall(x+1.5+dx*j/k,y+2+dy*j/k)) cansee = 0;
        if (cansee!=0) {
          mindist = dist;
          aimplayer = i;
          this.aimx = players[i].x;
          this.aimy = players[i].y;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if (mindist<=3) {
    this.runcounter = -1;
    this.mode = 3; // SLAYING
    setcharani sword,;
    timeout = 0.05;
  } else if (mindist<20) {
    if (this.mode!=2) message Stop!;
    this.runcounter = 100;
    this.mode = 2; // HUNTING
  } else timeout = 0.05;
}
if (timeout && this.mode==3) { // SLAYING
  this.runcounter++;
  if (this.runcounter>4) {
    this.runcounter = 100;
    this.mode = 2; // HUNTING
    setcharani idle,;
  }
  message;
  timeout = 0.05;
}
if (timeout && this.mode==2) { // HUNTING
  setcharani walk,;
  this.runcounter--;
  if (this.runcounter>0 && aimplayer<playerscount && players[aimplayer].hearts>0) {
    // Get new direction
    dx = players[aimplayer].x-x;
    dy = players[aimplayer].y-y;
    if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) {
      if (dx>0) dir=3; else dir=1;
    } else {
      if (dy>0) dir=2; else dir=0;
    }

    // Test if we can do a step
    dx = this.aimx-x;
    dy = this.aimy-y;
    if (abs(dx)<=1 && abs(dy)<=1) {
      this.aimx = players[aimplayer].x;;
      this.aimy = players[aimplayer].y;
      dx = this.aimx-x;
      dy = this.aimy-y;
    }
    if (abs(dx)>abs(dy)) {
      if (dx>0) testdir=3; else testdir=1;
    } else {
      if (dy>0) testdir=2; else testdir=0;
    }
    len = (dx*dx+dy*dy)^0.5;
    addx = (dx/len)*this.huntspeed;
    addy = (dy/len)*this.huntspeed;
    testx = x + 1.5;
    testy = y + 2;
    if (!onwall(testx+addx,testy+addy)) {
      // Do a step
      x += addx;
      y += addy;
    } else if (!onwall(testx+addx,testy)) x += addx;
    else if (!onwall(testx,testy+addy)) y += addy;
  } else {
    this.mode = 0; // WALKING
    this.walkmode = 1; // RANDOM
    this.runcounter = int(random(10,40));
    setcharani idle,;
    dir = (dir+2)%4;
    message;
  }
  timeout = 0.05;
}

// Hurting stuff
if (washit && this.mode!=1 && hearts>0) {
  dx = x-playerx;
  dy = y-playery;
  len = (dx*dx+dy*dy)^0.5;
  hurtdx = dx/len;
  hurtdy = dy/len;
  setcharani hurt,;
  hideimg 1;
  hearts -= playerswordpower/2;
}
if ((exploded || waspelt || wasshot) &&
  this.mode!=1 && hearts>0 && isleader) {
  hurtdx = -vecx(dir)*0.2;
  hurtdy = -vecy(dir)*0.2;
  setcharani hurt,;
  if (peltwithsign || peltwithvase || peltwithstone || peltwithnpc) hearts -= 1;
  else if (peltwithblackstone) hearts -= 1.5;
  else hearts -= 0.5;
}
if ((hurtdx!=0 || hurtdy!=0) && isleader && this.mode!=4) {
  this.hurtdx = hurtdx;
  this.hurtdy = hurtdy;
  hurtdx = 0;
  hurtdy = 0;
  if (hearts<=0) {
    this.mode = 4; // DYING
    message;
    setcharani dead,;
    timeout = 1.2;
  } else {
    this.mode = 1; // HURTED
    this.runcounter = 20;
    setcharani hurt,;
    timeout = 0.05;
  }
}
if (timeout && this.mode==1) { // HURTED
  this.runcounter--;
  if (this.runcounter>10) {
    testx = x + 1.5 + this.hurtdx*2;
    testy = y + 2 + this.hurtdy*2;
    if (!onwall(testx,testy)) {
      x += this.hurtdx;
      y += this.hurtdy;
    }
  }
  if (this.runcounter<=0) {
    if (swordpower>0) this.mode = 2; // HUNTING
    else this.mode = 0; // WALKING
    this.runcounter = 100;
    setcharani idle,;
  }
  timeout = 0.05;
}
if (timeout && this.mode==4) { // DYING
  destroy;
}

NPCEND
